_doc: Paraphrase set P (E5_DESIGN.md section 2, eval 5). Hand-written, NOT by the data builder: 2 templates per PopQA relation, each holding {subj} exactly once, none equal to PopQA's own wording. Written and reviewed by Opus BEFORE training; then record sha256 of the canonical JSON of `templates` (ko/e5_paraphrase.py: templates_sha256) in the notebook and pass it as --templates-sha256. Relations: capital, capital of, director, screenwriter, author, genre, country, producer, composer, father, mother, occupation, sport, religion, place of birth, color. Example shape: "occupation": ["template one with {subj}", "template two with {subj}"]. Empty on purpose: load_templates refuses an empty file.
